name: amp1_basic
description: AMP1's basic harness, the default: perception and object editing for any embodiment, with or without a mobile base; the model commands motion directly as TCP waypoints and the gripper, and on a robot with a base or a torso also by move_base and move_joints. It has no grasp or place proposals, planned motion or grasp-check helpers (its SDK copy has none of them); the robot, its gripper and cameras are read from the observation.
bootstrap:
import robolab_harness as rh
rh._trace.HARNESS = "amp1_basic"
ep = rh.connect(EPISODE_FILE, wait_ready_s=READY_TIMEOUT_S)

trace_kinds.harness.amp1_basic.connect: the episode became ready (or connect failed): instruction, wait
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_basic.plan: a manual preview: kind, ok, n_steps, error issues
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_basic.execute: a motion (execute, move_to, gripper, hold, home, stop, move_joints, move_base): its reply and the observed state after it
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_basic.objects: segment / define_object / forget_object / reperceive: the agent's edits to the scene
trace_kinds.harness.amp1_basic.request: one HTTP request the SDK sent: method, path, status, latency_s, bytes, and stack, the public ep methods that sent it, outermost first
